authority: the hub copy of each pool project's env bundle (BH-9889)
note: state/bundle-cache/<project>.raw (dir 700, file 600): bin/fly-envbundle.sh envbundle_cache_write (tmp + mv) after a good --pool ssh extract; read by envbundle_cache_read only when the owning box answers ssh rc 255, and only while younger than pool.env_bundle_cache_max_h. The owning box's env files are the record; a lost file costs one dark-box spawn that fails as before. One file per project, no growth past the project count. Kept out of the env dir on purpose: bin/harden-state.sh sets chattr +i there and bin/audit-tail.sh pages critical on writes under /etc/harness. Machine-local, never carried: bin/state-backup.sh excludes it from the R2 tar and its leak check refuses it like a plaintext env/ entry
